names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 12 iulie, «Sfântul Cuvios Paisie Aghioritul», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 29 июня ст. ст., «Преподобный Паисий Святогорец» (name page 14774), with the rank word at the head of the string left off. The line itself, «Прп. Паисия Святогорца (1994).», gives name and epithet in the genitive.

feast.note: **A different menologion number from this folder's other two rows, and the same civil day.** The Romanian and Greek rows stand on 12/7 revised-julian; the Julian 29 June is the civil 12 July 2026, so this calendar keeps him on the same day of the year by a different reckoning, and the row carries the Julian number as BRIEF-RUSSIAN §1 requires. His name page 14774 heads «Дни памяти: 1 июня (Афон.) , 29 июня , 31 декабря (прославление)»: the first is the synaxis of the saints of Athos, the third the day of his glorification, and neither is a second feast of the man. The line dates him «(1994)», which is the death year this folder already records off saint.gr, so nothing was changed. The name page prints no life of its own — an icon, and links to articles at pravoslavie.ru which were not opened. The day page prints no hymn under his name; its two hymns are of the chief apostles whose feast the day is.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Паисия Святогорца (1994).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 12 iulie — «Sfântul Cuvios Paisie Aghioritul»

attestations.note: doxologia.ro's life for this day is the life of this man — born at Pharasa in Cappadocia on 25 July 1924, baptised by the venerable Arsenios with his own name, and dying at the Suroti monastery — so the Romanian row is this folder's. The Romanian calendar keeps him on 12 iulie; this folder's Greek row cites saint.gr for 20 Σεπτεμβρίου, and why the two sites differ was not looked into (24 September 2026).

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 12 Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Παΐσιος ο Αγιορείτης». His own life page heads 12 Ιουλίου; the row read 20 Σεπτεμβρίου until 1 October 2026, taken from that page’s navigation strip, whose listing does not name him.

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs was read for 23 August – 19 September 2026; its page for this day was not read (26 August 2026).

birth.note: saint.gr: born at Pharasa in Cappadocia on 25 July 1924 AD.

death.note: saint.gr heads the entry «Όσιος Παΐσιος ο Αγιορείτης (1924 - 1994)».

hymns.text: Ὥσπερ ἄγγελος, φανεὶς ἐν κόσμῳ, ἐν τοῖς ἔτεσι, τοῖς τελευταίοις, χριστομίμητε Παΐσιε ὅσιε, ἀσκητικῶς γὰρ βιώσας ἐν Ἄθωνι, ὡς παμφαέστατος ἥλιος ἔλαμψας, καὶ κατηύγασας, πιστῶν τὰ πλήθη τῇ χάριτι, τοῖς ῥήμασι σημείοις καὶ τοῖς θαύμασι.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Όσιος Παΐσιος ο Αγιορείτης(1924 - 1994), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: As an angel wast thou made manifest in the world in these latter years, O venerable Paisios, imitator of Christ; for having lived in asceticism upon Athos, thou didst shine forth as a most radiant sun, and didst illumine the multitudes of the faithful by grace, by thy words, by signs and by wonders.

hymns.text: Παΐσιε γέγονας, τῶν ἀσκητῶν ἡ κρηπίς, τοῦ Ἄθωνος κλέϊσμα, καὶ Σουρωτῆς ὁ τροφός, Κονίτσης τὸ καύχημα, σὺ γὰρ ἐπὶ τὰ ἴχνη, Ἀρσενίου ὁδεύσας, εἴληφας χαρισμάτων, τὴν πληθὺν Παρακλήτου, ἀφθόνως τοῖς σὲ τιμῶσιν, παρέχων τὰ πρόσφορα.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Όσιος Παΐσιος ο Αγιορείτης(1924 - 1994), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: O Paisios, thou hast become the firm foundation of ascetics, the glory of Athos and the nourisher of Souroti, the boast of Konitsa; for having walked in the footsteps of Arsenios, thou didst receive the fullness of the gifts of the Comforter, ungrudgingly bestowing upon them that honour thee whatsoever they have need of.

hymns.text: Τὸν πανεύφημον ἄνδρα, τοῦ ὄρους Ἄθωνος, τὸν ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν χρόνων, καθάπερ φάος λαμπρόν, τὴν σκοτίαν τῶν πιστῶν διασκεδάσαντα, καὶ νοσήματα ψυχῶν, καὶ σαρκὸς ἐπιφοράς, ἰώμενον ὑπὲρ φύσιν, τῆς προοράσεως λύχνον, νέον Παΐσιον τιμήσωμεν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Όσιος Παΐσιος ο Αγιορείτης(1924 - 1994), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: Let us honour the all-praised man of the mountain of Athos, who in these last times, like a bright light, hath scattered the darkness of the faithful, and who healeth beyond nature the sicknesses of souls and the assaults of the flesh: the lamp of foresight, the new Paisios.

hymns.text: Ἁγίου Ὄρους ἀσκητὴν τὸν περιάκουστον, καὶ Ἐκκλησίας τὸν φωστῆρα τὸν νεόφωτον, ἐπαινέσωμεν ἐν ὕμνοις ὁλοκαρδίως, ποδηγῶν γὰρ τοὺς πιστοὺς πρὸς βίον ἄριστον, ποταμῶν τῶν δωρημάτων τούτους ἔπλησας, διὸ κράζουσι· Χαίροις πάτερ Παΐσιε.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Όσιος Παΐσιος ο Αγιορείτης(1924 - 1994), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Κοντάκιον

english.text: Let us praise with hymns and with our whole heart the far-renowned ascetic of the Holy Mountain and the newly-shining luminary of the Church; for guiding the faithful toward the most excellent life, thou didst fill them with rivers of gifts. Wherefore they cry aloud: Rejoice, O father Paisios.

hymns.text: Pe bărbatul ales din Muntele Athonului, pe cel ce-n vremurile cele din urmă întunericul a risipit ca un luminător, bolile tuturor vindecând, pe Paisie cel Nou să-l lăudăm credincioșii; căci el se roagă neîncetat pentru întreaga lume.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Paisie Aghioritul», Glasul 5

english.text: Let us the faithful praise the chosen man of the mountain of Athos, who in the last times scattered the darkness like a lamp and healed the sicknesses of all — Paisios the New; for he prays without ceasing for the whole world.

track.note: Born 25 July 1924, "a few days before the people of Pharasa left their ancestral ground for Greece" — a stay of days, which is why it opens and closes in one year.

Childhood and youth; the army from 1945 to 1949 and a first look at the Holy Mountain after it are in the life and are not drawn; back as a carpenter for three years, "in 1953, at twenty-nine" he left for good.
Rasophore 27 March 1954; Philotheou, a few kilometres down the same peninsula, from about 1956, small schema 12 March 1956.
The ruined monastery of the Panagia of Stomio near Konitsa, from August 1958, "four years".
The cell of Galaction and Episteme, until the climate sent him home.

Iviron, then Katounakia (1967), Stavronikita (1968) and the Panagouda (1979) — four cells on one peninsula, which the 15 km covers. The operation of 1966 and the convalescence at Souroti are a journey inside this stay and are not drawn.
He left the Mountain for the last time in November 1993 for the feast of St Arsenius here, fell ill, and died in the Theagenio hospital in Thessaloniki on 12 July 1994; buried at the hesychasterion.
